type.description:
`new_post`, `new_comment`, `new_like_post`, `new_like_comment`,
`mention`, `on_this_day`, `new_chat_message`, `new_direct_message`,
`trip_checkin`, `album_photo`, `new_story`, `story_reply`,
`story_reaction`, `gift_list_invite`, `gift_draw`, or
`gift_list_updated`. A `gift_draw` message never names your
recipient. A direct-message notification uses generic copy and
never includes the sender's message excerpt.

relatedStoryId.description: Set instead of `relatedPostId` for story notifications; `null` once the story is gone.

relatedChatConversationId.description:
Set for `new_direct_message`, so the client can deep-link to the
conversation. Null or absent for other notification types and
cleared if the conversation is deleted.
